is: each place's sounds that belong to no object: the room tones it plays all the time (loops, by their names in data/sound/catalogue.json and sounds.json), and, outside on the Moon, what is heard through the suit instead (heard_through), which tools/usd/sound.py writes into the place's stage as non-spatial UsdMedia.SpatialAudio; and the sounds of a thing in the place whose inventory row names none (objects: the sound and the inventory row id or scene object it plays at, spatial), each place's additions said in `added`. The sound stage (score/stages/sound) makes the place's sound layer from these.
